model: Frozen Kumo Large90 + spline logit-offset correction12/new features + fixed spline77
formula: p=.75*sigmoid(z+strength*(beta0+beta_z*(z-mean_train)/sd_train+phi(x)@beta_features))+.25*p_spline77; z=logit(clip(p_Kumo,1e-6,1-1e-6)); mean test predictions of five folds
training_objective: mean(logaddexp(0,z+Xbeta)-y*(z+Xbeta)) + penalty/2*sum(beta[1:]**2); fit full correction, apply strength only at inference
preprocessing: Signed log(sign(x)*log1p(abs(x))), correction-training median imputation, quadratic quantile spline3knots, standardization; missing bits and categorical one-hot; training-fold fit only
validation: Original identical5fold StratifiedKFold seed31027; per fold50k Kumo context,6k correction fit,14k validation; no automatic competition submission
base_feature_definitions: BASELINE_LOCK.json, README.md, original frozen feature provenance retained
